d:
Something NEW & BIG revealed in India!
After traveling all the way from California to Chandigarh, I finally got the opportunity to meet my amazing fans and followers in person.
This was not an open event. It was private event, only selected people came to the event. It was a special day filled with motivation, conversations, energy, love, and a BIG surprise!
In this vlog, I'm taking you behind the scenes of my India event, where I met my community, shared my thoughts about the fitness industry, delivered a motivational speech, and revealed something I've been working on for a long time.
